name: Monyoród (Hungary)
description: White field with a wavy blue stripe and a green stripe along the bottom edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Monyoród (a green shield with a bunch of grapes and a white ploughshare) above a scroll inscribed MONYORÓD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
